start_here: Say to your AI: "Let a member leave a shared space; what they put there stays", with {"space":"sample-club","subject":"ana@example.com"}. It runs tool:leave-a-space and answers {"space":"sample-club","subject":"ana@example.com","left":false,"state":"none"}
no_lists_because: It names no list of yours: it takes its input and keeps only its own rows (record:space, record:space-member) through the records door.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Let a member leave a shared space; what they put there stays", and give it space (The space's id, the last part of its record:space row id); subject (The person, the way the space and your access rules name them).
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:leave-a-space and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: Marks the person's record:space-member row left and stamps when.
4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: record:space (records:read); record:space-member (records:read, records:list, records:write).
